title: 1990 Topps Woolworth Highlights #13 Carlton Fisk Chicago White Sox
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1990 Topps Woolworth Baseball Highlights trading card featuring Carlton Fisk of the Chicago Whitesox. The card is part of the White parallel/variety set and is card number 13 in the series. It is a sports trading card for collectors and fans of baseball memorabilia.
